lines.speaker: Lena
lines.text: Hi, I'm calling about invoice 618. We were charged twice for the same service visit.

lines.speaker: Billing agent
lines.text: I'm sorry about that. Could you tell me what appears on the statement?

lines.speaker: Lena
lines.text: Two charges of one hundred forty dollars were posted on Tuesday. They have different transaction numbers, but both refer to invoice 618.

lines.speaker: Billing agent
lines.text: And only one invoice was issued?

lines.speaker: Lena
lines.text: Correct. This invoice was already paid by the first transaction. The itemized invoice lists one call-out fee, one hour of labor and standard fasteners. The total is one hundred forty dollars.

lines.speaker: Billing agent
lines.text: Let me check the payment record. Please hold for a moment.

lines.speaker: Billing agent
lines.text: Thank you for waiting. I can see that the first payment was processed normally. The second payment was processed during a terminal retry, but no second invoice or visit was created.

lines.speaker: Lena
lines.text: So the evidence shows one valid payment and one duplicate charge.

lines.speaker: Billing agent
lines.text: Yes. A refund has been issued for the duplicate one hundred forty dollars.

lines.speaker: Lena
lines.text: When will it be credited to the arts center's card?

lines.speaker: Billing agent
lines.text: It should be credited within three to five business days. The exact posting time is controlled by the card provider.

lines.speaker: Lena
lines.text: Could you confirm that in writing, including which transaction was refunded?

lines.speaker: Billing agent
lines.text: Certainly. A confirmation email will be sent today. It will include the refunded transaction number, the amount, today's processing date and a refund reference.

lines.speaker: Lena
lines.text: Will the original payment or invoice be changed?

lines.speaker: Billing agent
lines.text: No. The original invoice remains paid. Only the duplicate transaction is being reversed.

lines.speaker: Lena
lines.text: Good. If the credit hasn't appeared after five business days, what should we provide?

lines.speaker: Billing agent
lines.text: Reply to the confirmation email with the refund reference and a current statement screenshot. Please hide unrelated transactions and full card details.

lines.speaker: Lena
lines.text: Thank you. I'll wait for the written confirmation and follow up only if the stated window passes.

transfer.instruction: 先听两遍，记录发票、金额、卡片末四位、参考号、到账窗口和超期后的动作。
